_doc: Per-bonfire look targets for DSR Lighting Engine ('PTDE moods, DSR fidelity'). Machine-authoritative copy of the W1 look bibles looks/G1..G5.md after the W1 critic pass (looks/README.md explains every rule). All targets are DELTAS of captures/<run>/<variant>/<slug>.stats.json against the baseline: ev_delta = new ev - baseline ev (EV, log2 geometric-mean luminance; for exposure_metric 'p50' the exposure check uses log2(lin(p50_new)/lin(p50_base)) instead and ev becomes advisory); sat_ratio = new mean_sat / baseline mean_sat; oklab_a/b_delta = change of mid_oklab_a/b (+a magenta, +b warm); clip_max_delta / crush_max_delta = largest allowed rise in percentage points (NEGATIVE = must fall by at least that much); clip_min_delta = largest allowed fall; floors = absolute minimum p10/p50/p90 (8-bit luma); pctl_delta = allowed change of p10/p50/p90/p99 in 8-bit levels (null = unbounded); spread_delta = change of log2((p90+1)/(p10+1)); abs_limits = absolute bounds on a stats field; char_ev_delta / d_char_env = character-crop checks (tools/check_looks.py --crops); enforce = per-metric on/off; sun = sun class (sun_classes below), sun_detail = the rows; signoff = the first capture of this move needs the user's approval even when it passes. Checked by tools/check_looks.py.

_baseline.guardrail: re-baseline: frozen shaders + vanilla DrawParam (PLAN 'freeze shaders + re-baseline'), suggested captures/rebaseline/vanilla. Until it exists, captures/baseline_vanilla/vanilla (Phase 0, vanilla shaders).
_baseline.before_after: captures/baseline_vanilla/vanilla (Phase 0) for the user-facing before/after only.

_noise.rule: judge views with a bonfire in or near frame on the mean of 2 captures (check_looks.py --repeat)

sun_classes._formula: c6 = (col_s/255 * colA_s/100)^2.2 per channel (LightBank); sun radiance = 2 * c6, largest channel capped at 0.6 (colA_s 58)
